The other option is booking the reservation with your points through the Chase Travel portal.
- Sign in to your account at the Chase Travel portal.
- Choose the credit card account you wish to use to redeem points.
- Select “Redeem” next to your points balance.

A collection is a type of derogatory remark that can last up to 7 years or more on your credit report.
